source_instruction: i am looking for light blonde hair extensions that are 18 inches long.
query: I stopped at the little food cart by the mall entrance on my way in today, and the sweet older lady running it handed me a free warm cinnamon sugar pretzel bite just because she said I looked like I was having a slow, meandering kind of afternoon. It was still soft and oozing a little melted butter when I took the first bite, and it made me think of the weekends my grandma used to bake the same exact treat when I was a kid, letting me sprinkle on way too much sugar before they went in the oven. I wandered past the window display of the candle shop a minute later, too, and caught a whiff of that fresh pine and vanilla scent that always makes me feel like the holiday season is just around the corner even when it’s still bright and sunny out. Right now I’m browsing the hair loss products section. I’ve heard there are hair toppers available, in 18 inch length, with a $60 max price point, in that light highlighted blonde shade the store carries.
